settings.title: What's in the box
settings.purpose: Identify every part before the instructions refer to it.
settings.alt_1: Every KRYO component laid out: the cooling unit, Halo, hose, mounting rail, sliding connector, seals, PSU and fill plug
settings.detail: Remove loose components packed around the sides and back before lifting KRYO out. KRYO and its packaging are around 10 kg, so lift carefully with both hands and bend through your knees.
The cooling unit. It holds the water, chills it and pumps it to the Halo.
The ring-shaped water delivery component that mounts above you and spreads cold water across the shoulders and upper body.
Controls water flow at the Halo.
Opens or stops water leaving KRYO.
Carries water between KRYO and the Halo. A rubber seal sits inside each fitting.
The vertical adhesive rail that fixes to the wall and carries the Halo.
Slides inside the rail and holds the Halo at your chosen height.
Converts the wall supply to 24V DC for KRYO. It must stay dry.
Closes the fill opening on top of KRYO after you add water.
One sits flat inside each threaded water fitting.
Supplied for removing and refitting the rail end cap.

settings.title: Position & mount
settings.purpose: Plan the complete layout, then mount the rail once it works.
settings.critical: Do not apply the rail adhesive until the complete layout has been checked.
settings.detail:
Dry-fit first. Assemble KRYO, hose, Halo, rail and power supply and hold everything in place before anything is fixed. Keep the airflow area and vents unobstructed, and point the spray away from the display and power side.

Prepare the wall. It must be smooth, clean and completely dry.

Assemble the rail. Remove one rail end cap with the Phillips screwdriver, insert the sliding height connector, confirm it moves freely, then refit the end cap.

Mount it. Align the rail, then apply firm, even pressure across every adhesive point. The adhesive is difficult to reposition once it has made contact.

Set the Halo. Adjust it to height and confirm it is secure before use.
settings.alt_1: KRYO upright on a level floor with the rear airflow area kept clear

settings.text: Place KRYO upright on a stable, level floor and dry-fit the complete layout.
settings.detail: Hold the rail, hose and Halo in place before anything is fixed to the wall.
settings.image_alt: Planning where KRYO, the hose, the Halo and the power supply will sit before mounting

settings.text: Check hose reach, power reach and refill access.
settings.detail: The hose must reach without pulling or kinking, the PSU must reach a suitable outlet, and a bidet or shower hose must reach the fill opening.

settings.text: Set the Halo at least 30 cm above the tallest user. 40 to 50 cm is preferred where possible.
settings.detail: A higher Halo spreads water further across the shoulders and upper body.
settings.image_alt: Halo height guide showing 30 cm minimum and 40 to 50 cm preferred above the tallest user's head

settings.text: Mount the rail only once the complete layout works.
settings.detail: Clean and dry the wall, align the rail, then press firmly and evenly. Adjust the Halo height afterwards and confirm it is secure.
settings.image_alt: Pressing the mounting rail firmly and evenly onto the prepared wall

settings.title: Connect
settings.purpose: Connect the Halo, hose and power.
settings.critical:
Seal flat. Fit squarely. Hand-tight only.

Keep the PSU, plug and mains outlet dry.
settings.detail:
If a fitting leaks. Stop the flow, disconnect, check the seal is present and sitting flat, reconnect squarely, hand-tighten, then test again.

Check these three joints:

  • hose to KRYO
  • hose to Halo flow adjuster
  • flow adjuster to Halo
settings.alt_1: Attaching the hose to the Halo flow adjuster

settings.text: Check every threaded fitting has a rubber seal sitting flat.
settings.detail: A missing, twisted or pinched seal is the most common cause of leaking.

settings.text: Connect the hose to the Halo flow adjuster.
settings.detail: Start the threads square. Hand-tighten only — do not cross-thread and do not overtighten.

settings.text: Connect the other end to the KRYO outlet.
settings.detail: Check the hose then follows a smooth path with no sharp kink.
settings.image_alt: Attaching the other end of the hose to the KRYO outlet

settings.detail: KRYO outlet control — opens or stops water leaving KRYO. Halo flow adjuster — controls water flow at the Halo. Leave both closed until you are ready to prime.

settings.text: Connect KRYO's 24V DC lead to the supplied PSU, then the PSU to a suitable dry mains outlet.
settings.detail: Keep KRYO switched off and dry your hands first. Place the PSU and its connection outside the splash zone and route cables away from water and foot traffic.

settings.title: Fill & start
settings.purpose: Prime KRYO, start circulation and fill it safely.
settings.critical:
Never run the pump dry.

Never set below 1°C. Never allow the reservoir to freeze.
settings.detail:
Fill slowly with the internal light on so you can see the level. Do not overfill into the upper internal area, and dry the top before replacing the plug.

Harsh dry-running sound, or no circulation. Switch KRYO off immediately, add water, and restart only once adequately primed.

Spitting, pulsing or inconsistent flow. Water is likely low. Stop and refill.

Repeated knocking or re-pressurising. Check both controls are closed and check the connections and seals. Contact support if it persists.

No internal light. Check the KRYO DC connection, the PSU and the mains connection.
settings.alt_1: Opening the fill plug on top of KRYO to add water

settings.text: Open the fill plug and add water before operating the pump.
settings.detail: Unscrew the plug by hand. No tools are required. Running the pump dry can damage it.

settings.checklist:
• Water has been added
  • KRYO outlet control is closed
  • Halo flow adjuster is closed
  • PSU, plug and mains outlet are dry

settings.text: Switch KRYO on and confirm normal operation.
settings.checklist: KRYO is ready when: the internal light is on, circulation sounds normal, there are no visible leaks and there is no harsh dry-running sound.
settings.image_alt: Switching KRYO on once water has been added

settings.text: Continue filling slowly, refit the plug and set approximately 15°C for first use.
settings.detail: Dry the top surface before refitting the plug, then press SET and choose roughly 15°C.

settings.title: First use
settings.purpose: Start gently and learn the correct body position.
settings.critical:
Do not start with the water on your face or chest.

Do not hyperventilate or hold your breath.
settings.detail:
The upper back and shoulders are the largest, least sensitive area, which lets your breathing settle before the cold reaches your chest.

Sudden cold may cause an involuntary gasp and rapid breathing. Keep the first exposure short and comfortable.
settings.always_visible:
• Chest pain, pressure or tightness
  • Severe breathlessness
  • Dizziness or faintness
  • Confusion
  • Loss of coordination
  • Uncontrolled shivering
  • Racing or irregular heartbeat
  • Panic or loss of breathing control

If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, stop the water, step out carefully and sit or lie somewhere safe.
settings.alt_1: First session position: back to the Halo so the first water hits the upper back and shoulders, never the face or chest

settings.text: Stand with your back to the Halo.
Slowly open the Halo flow adjuster.
Let the first water hit your shoulders and upper back.
Breathe normally and let the initial cold response settle.
